يهتلكوا (form VIII)
# يَهْتَلِكُوا (yahtalikū) /jah.ta.li.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# يُهْتَلَكُوا (yuhtalakū) /juh.ta.la.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
